scope: Exploratory spelling sensitivity, no phonetic/name fitting. Distinguish zodiac figure/star labels from detached astronomical star labels. No cross-reading pooling or significance claims.
exposure: Anchor, proposed cores, source corpus and prior raw ranks already seen. Rules frozen before new transformed scores. This is not untouched confirmation.
views: EVA characters and longest cth/ckh/cph/cfh/ch/sh groups. Prefix lengths in first_k refer to units of the chosen view, preventing cutting a grouped symbol. Anchor o/a/l are single units in both views.
transformation_meanings: raw unchanged; literal_o/oa/oal removes exactly that opening only when present; first_1/2/3 removes that many initial units from EVERY token as a broader equal-width sensitivity. Candidate becomes oalcheg/alcheg/lcheg/cheg. These are competing hypotheses, not accepted morphological analyses. Empty residues excluded with counts, unknown barriers never promoted.
zodiac: H and V separately. Same raw training/test allocation as v82: six other hand4 sign panels training, four Aries/Taurus panels test. Only S figure/star labels. All target signs excluded from fitting. Target peer vocabulary is distinct transformed types, not duplicated spelling collisions. Save collisions. U/K/C/Q target rows retained as reading alternatives; insufficient coverage for equivalent six-sign models.
detached_stars: H/U/V separately. Train f68r1 S, compare with f68r2 S; repeat reverse direction, never select better direction. Only53 physical S loci, sparse page-specific models; these stars are a different label format from zodiac figures. Descriptive context sensitivity, not independent matched replication. f68r3 cluster and connector excluded from this individual-star cohort. F absent from these star-label panels.
model: Same add-half within-word bigram surprise as v82, including word boundaries; explicit unseen-unit bucket. Train after identical transformation of all reference words. No body-text training. Save start/interior/end transition contributions and symbol counts, so terminal-g scarcity stays visible.
rank: Anchor residual compared with distinct reference/test transformed types of EXACT same unit length and EXACT training transformed-string count. At least5 peers. Strict-less plus half ties; descriptive percentile, not p/confidence. Anchor omitted from peer set if present. Save all low-support/missing ranks without relaxed matching. Compare ranks across transforms as sensitivities, not effect sizes because peer sets change.
qualification: Before scoring: fixed v82-style artificial template unusual-over-normal gate, parser grouping check, explicit unseen-symbol detection. Then verify raw zodiac H/V target surprises and percentiles exactly reproduce saved v82 results. Engineering only; not biological/phonetic/statistical validation.
limits: Functional prefixes could have varying length or context; neither literal nor equal-width removal exhausts possible mechanisms. All narrow endings/reading ambiguities remain. No best transform chosen from outcomes. No historical names or sounds fitted.
